sources.title: The Chubby Lock Service for Loosely-Coupled Distributed Systems
sources.author: Mike Burrows
sources.finding: Lock sequencers include lock generation and are carried to protected operations so recipients reject stale sequencers. This strongly supports operation-time fencing and destroys novelty claims for the general fencing pattern.

sources.title: Propositions as Sessions
sources.author: Philip Wadler
sources.finding: Linear logic corresponds to session-typed communication; linear resources/session progression are established prior art for non-freely-duplicable protocol state.

sources.title: Understanding Ownership
sources.finding: Rust ownership/move semantics provide an established practical analogue for unique ownership and invalidation after move; this is an analogy, not Frank task authority.

sources.title: Temporal API protocol documentation — HistoryEvent
sources.finding: Workflow history events are persisted with monotonically increasing event IDs and are used by SDKs to advance/recreate workflow state; durable replay is established prior art.

counterevidence: No source supports a claim that LICF as a broad mechanism is world-first. The ingredients have strong prior art. Search did not establish an exact prior implementation of a ClayCode self.root task-continuation fiber spanning GWT/reentry/effects, so narrow classification remains NOVEL_COMBINATION_CANDIDATE rather than NEW_MECHANISM_CANDIDATE.
freshness_note: External mechanisms are mostly stable historic foundations; current 2026 Rust and Temporal documentation were checked to avoid relying on stale interface descriptions.
